subject.title: fix(i18n): sync Apple catalog with the Linux CI runner

question: Should this maintainer-labeled Linux-generated i18n artifact update merge once the remaining required checks finish successfully?
rationale: The patch is intentionally restricted to generated native localization artifacts, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision rather than automated disposition.

options.title: Merge after required checks
options.body: Confirm the remaining required checks are green and merge the Linux-regenerated artifacts as the CI-canonical output.

options.title: Hold for generator investigation
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want the cross-filesystem discovery difference resolved in the generator before accepting regenerated output.

recommendation.title: Merge after required checks
recommendation.body: Confirm the remaining required checks are green and merge the Linux-regenerated artifacts as the CI-canonical output.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the Linux regeneration and native-i18n verification context for the affected iOS artifact path.
